aggregate.refined_verdict: PARTIAL_LIFT_v2 — sa_weight 0.3 holds at 3.099 across 30 cells (10 pockets × 3 seeds) vs TargetDiff 2.65-2.86. Pool-driven plateau: --sa-weight guides MCTS scoring but the FRAGMENT POOL itself is dominated by Pt-acetylide scaffolds (SA~2-3) + Pt-Cl2 fragments (SA~5-6). To close the -0.24 gap further, fragment-pool optimization (TODO-25 Tier-2 P2.3) is the upstream fix, not channel-weight tuning.

verdict: PARTIAL_LIFT — SA penalty + filtered pool lift sa_mean from ≥5.0 → 3.099 (closer to TargetDiff range but still 0.24-0.45 above target). Real lift blocked by n_sim=100 budget + rule symmetry. Recommend 3x3 at n_sim=1000.
